q: By February 28, 2027, the Polish parliament passes the 2027 budget act, and the 2027 defense spending (the state budget and the Armed Forces Support Fund combined) published by the Ministry of Finance or the Ministry of National Defense immediately after passage is 4.5 percent of GDP or more
basis: The 2027 draft budget adopted by the Council of Ministers in late August 2026 puts defense spending at about 198.1 billion zlotys (4.51 percent of GDP), just above the threshold. The president signed the 2026 budget act on January 19 and referred it to the Constitutional Tribunal for follow-up review. Cuts during parliamentary deliberations or a revised GDP forecast could push the figure below 4.5 percent. At the first reading on October 8, 2026, Poland's lower house defeated a motion to reject the 2027 draft budget, 198 in favor and 237 against, and sent it to committee.
rs: The Polish parliament's passage of the budget act and the defense spending figure published by Poland's Ministry of Finance or Ministry of National Defence
